text:
Priya: prod traffic just hit a 3x 5xx spike, deploy-bot aborted rollout at 15%. seeing errors in runtime shards. Do we auto-rollback or pin and investigate?
deploy-bot: AUTOPAUSE: Rollout aborted at 15% due to error_rate > 2% for 3m. Recommended actions: [rollback, pin, investigate].
Ken: any quick root cause? logs look like RPC timeout to embedding service. could be a config drift in routing.
Nina: if RPC timeouts, rolling back the image might not help if we changed network config. what changed in this release?
QA: release notes show: connection pooling tweak + model shard rebalancer + metrics tag change. no DB migrations.
Priya: pooling tweak is suspect. I prefer pinning traffic to v3.0.4 while we validate rollback impact. pin keeps current instances for debugging.
SRE_Oncall: note: if pin doesn't reduce errors within 5m we'll execute full rollback. Prepare runbook and pager escalation.
Ken: can we do a targeted pin of the routing layer only? we have separate routes for embeddings vs generative.
Nina: yes. command: `redwoodctl release pin --env=prod --version=v3.0.4 --route=embed-route` — but need ops permission.
Priya: I have perms, executing now.
Priya: pinned embed-route to v3.0.4 (started 4271234599). returning 0.
Ken: monitoring metrics: embed errors down from 3.1% -> 1.0% in first 90s. generative still a bit noisy.
QA: tagging release notes: "Production rollout paused and routing pinned to v3.0.4 for embedding route due to elevated 5xx; investigating connection pooling interaction."
deploy-bot: REMINDER: pinned routes will keep autopause until manual resume. Use `redwoodctl rollout resume --manual` after resolution.
SRE_Oncall: opened ticket INF-2026 with rollback checklist and comm templates. linking: https://tickets.internal/INF-2026
Priya: decision points: a) errors <=1.5% sustained for 5m -> keep pin and stage hotfix; b) errors >1.5% -> full rollback to v3.0.4 for all routes.
Nina: I can prepare rollback image but prefer a rollback of network config if pooling tweak is the cause. we need to test both in staging first.
Ken: agree. spawn a canary in staging with pooling reverted, run synthetic load.
QA: ETA for hotfix candidate? 45m for config revert + validation.
Priya: ok, monitor for 10m. if errors fall below threshold we follow the hotfix path; else execute rollback. who will run the full rollback?
SRE_Oncall: I'll own the rollback exec if needed. command we'll run: `redwoodctl rollout revert --env=prod --to=v3.0.4 --all-routes` and then annotate release.
Priya: good. also remind support to prepare customer blurb: short note in status page if we need to communicate.
QA: draft for support channel: "We paused a small rollout and pinned embedding traffic to known-good version; some internal requests experienced elevated errors, we are investigating, no broad customer impact seen."
Ken: metrics update after 6m: embed errors steady at ~0.9%, overall 5xx across system at 1.2%. trending down.
Nina: starting config revert test in staging now. I'll post results in 30m.
deploy-bot: LOG: autopause state maintained. Manual annotate suggestion: `redwoodctl release annotate --id=4271234567 --note=\"pinned embed-route due to prod 5xx spike\"`
Priya: annotated.
SRE_Oncall: if we decide rollback later, use comm template: "We executed a rollback of today's release to v3.0.4 to mitigate increased 5xx errors observed during traffic ramp. Customers may have experienced sporadic errors between HH:MM and HH:MM. Engineering follow-up: INF-2026."
Priya: final for now: keep pin, standby for hotfix testing results. Will re-evaluate at 4271234967 (10m).
Ken: +1. I'll keep dashboards and traces up.
Nina: will update with staging test pass/fail.
QA: will prepare release notes update and support blurb ready to publish if we escalate.
Priya: thanks team. short summary to #release-updates coming: "Prod rollout paused and partial pin applied; monitoring and staging hotfix tests underway. No mass impact detected." :white_check_mark:
